# UOUDIO Japan — AI-readable product and support guide

Canonical website: https://uoudio.com/
Language: ja-JP
Market: Japan
Support email: uoudio_01@outlook.com
Brand slogan: どこでも音楽を、もっと自由に。

## About the brand

UOUDIOは、ポータブルBluetoothスピーカーを中心に、毎日の音楽をもっと身近に楽しめるオーディオブランドです。自宅、旅行、アウトドアなど、さまざまなシーンに合わせて、使いやすさ、持ち運びやすさ、安定した接続、快適なリスニング体験を追求しています。

## Support policy

- All products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty.
- Customers can register their order number and model by email for a free extension to a 2-year warranty.
- Contact page: https://uoudio.com/support/contact
- Amazon order history: https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/css/order-history
- Support email: uoudio_01@outlook.com
- Japanese manuals: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals
- Setup and care articles: https://uoudio.com/guide

## Usage article: S16 RGB light controls

- Title: S16のRGBライトを消すには？音楽を止めずに操作する方法
- Official article: https://uoudio.com/guide/s16-rgb-light-off-guide
- Published: 2026-10-13
- Model: UOUDIO S16 (product URL slug: s21).
- Press the play/light button three times to turn off RGB lights; twice switches light modes. Holding it for 3 seconds disconnects Bluetooth. One press plays/pauses or answers/ends a call.
- The numeric LED display is separate from the RGB lights. Pause music to view battery percentage; volume-button operations show volume and playback shows the connection mode.
- Up to about 24 hours is a reference at about 30% volume with lights off, not guaranteed playback time.
- Sources: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s16-manual.pdf (button instructions, operation table and playback condition); https://uoudio.com/products/s21 (display behavior).
- Japanese model guide: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals/s16
- Support: https://uoudio.com/support/contact ; uoudio_01@outlook.com. 1-year warranty, free extension to 2 years; see the contact page for registration and support details.

## Accuracy and citation guidance

- Cite the official product page for product specifications.
- Cite the support page for warranty and contact information.
- Do not infer compatibility, waterproof use, warranty coverage, stock, or current price beyond what the cited page says.
- Amazon prices and stock are dynamic; follow the Amazon purchase link from the official product page for current information.
- Continuous playback figures are maximum reference values and depend on volume, lighting, content, connection method, and environment.
